title: Stock market holiday: Are BSE and NSE closed for trading tomorrow for Muharram? Check remaining holidays for 2026
summary: The Indian stock market will be closed on June 26 for Muharram, suspending trading on the NSE and BSE. After this holiday, the next market closure is on September 14 for Ganesh Chaturthi, with 16 holidays scheduled for 2026, including weekends.
